name: piwin
description: Private coding agent shell on Pi (UI + CLI)

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:architecture
scripts.test:cold-storage: pnpm --filter @piwin/contracts exec vitest run src/session-storage.test.ts src/session-cold-storage.test.ts && pnpm --filter @piwin/session exec vitest run src/session-pack.test.ts src/session-cold-storage.test.ts && pnpm --filter @piwin/host-runtime exec vitest run src/session-cold-storage.integration.test.ts src/session-storage-residency.integration.test.ts src/session-storage-coordinator.test.ts src/commands/session-pack-commands.test.ts && pnpm --filter @piwin/cli exec vitest run src/session-cold-storage-command.test.ts src/session-pack-command.test.ts src/host-serve-command-lane.test.ts && pnpm --dir apps/desktop exec vitest run src/session-storage-ui.test.ts src/settings/cold-storage-draft.test.ts src/settings/pages/session-cold-storage-page.test.tsx
scripts.package:host: pnpm bundle:host && pnpm fetch:node-runtime && node scripts/package-host.mjs
scripts.automated-prerequisite-gate: pnpm check && pnpm e2e:desktop && pnpm e2e:host-jsonl && cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo check --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
